question: How long does a refund take to reach my account?
answer: Refunds are sent to your original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive your return. UPI and card refunds usually appear in 3-5 days; bank transfers can take up to 7.

question: How do I get a refund for a cancelled order?
answer: Once an order is cancelled, the refund starts automatically. Prepaid orders are refunded to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

question: Where do I enter my bank details for a COD refund?
answer: For cash-on-delivery orders, add your bank account details under Account > Bank Details after the return is approved. The refund is transferred within 7-10 business days.

question: What happens if my refund fails?
answer: If a refund fails, we retry the original payment method. If it still fails after 7 days, contact support with your order id and we will arrange a bank transfer.

question: What is the return window?
answer: Most items can be returned within 7 days of delivery. The item must be unused with tags attached and in its original packaging.

question: How do I start a return?
answer: Open Orders > select the item > Return, choose a reason, and pick a pickup slot. A courier partner will collect the item from your address.

question: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
answer: Yes. Choose Exchange when starting a return within 7 days of delivery. Exchanges depend on size and stock availability for the same product.

question: Are all items returnable?
answer: No. Innerwear, cosmetics, perishables, and personalised items cannot be returned for hygiene or customisation reasons. The product page marks these as non-returnable.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking, wallets, and cash on delivery. Card and UPI payments are confirmed instantly.

question: What is the cash-on-delivery limit?
answer: Cash on delivery is available up to ₹10,000 per order. Some pin codes and high-value items are prepaid only.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: A payment can fail if your bank declines the transaction, the card limit is reached, or the OTP session expires. No money is captured for a failed payment; retry with another method.

question: Is there a delivery fee?
answer: Delivery is free on orders above ₹499. Orders below that have a flat ₹49 delivery fee, shown at checkout before payment.

question: Can I pay in instalments?
answer: No-cost EMI is available on selected cards for orders above ₹3,000. Eligible options appear at checkout after you select a card.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Delivery takes 3-5 days in metro cities and 5-7 days elsewhere. The exact date is shown on the product page and at checkout.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: A tracking link is sent by SMS and email when the order ships. You can also open Orders > Track in your account for live status.

question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
answer: You can change the address before the order is packed. Open Orders > Change Address. After dispatch, the address cannot be changed.

question: What if I miss the delivery?
answer: The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. After that, the order returns to our warehouse and the refund is processed automatically.

question: Is express delivery available?
answer: Express delivery is available in selected metro pin codes for eligible items. Order before 2 PM to get same-day dispatch; the option appears at checkout when available.

question: How do I cancel an order?
answer: Open Orders > Cancel before the order ships. Cancellation is free at that stage and the refund starts immediately for prepaid orders.

question: Can I cancel an order after it has shipped?
answer: No. Once the order ships it cannot be cancelled. You can refuse the delivery or return the item after it arrives.

question: Is there a cancellation fee?
answer: No. Cancelling before dispatch is always free. Refusing a delivery may lead to the delivery fee not being refunded.

question: Can I cancel part of an order?
answer: Yes, if the items ship separately. Open Orders, select the item you want to cancel, and cancel it individually. The refund is adjusted for that item only.

question: How do I download my invoice?
answer: Open Orders > select the order > Invoice. The PDF invoice can be downloaded or emailed to you from that page.

question: Why is my order still pending?
answer: An order stays pending while the payment is being confirmed or the item is being packed. If it is pending for more than 24 hours, contact support with the order id.

question: Why do I need an OTP for delivery?
answer: For orders above ₹5,000, a one-time password is sent to your registered phone number to confirm the right person receives the parcel. Share it with the courier at delivery; it cannot be pre-set.

question: Can I place a bulk order?
answer: For 10 or more units of the same item, contact our business desk from the Bulk Orders page. Bulk pricing and GST invoicing are handled separately.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the login page, choose Forgot Password and enter your registered email or phone. A reset link or OTP is sent within a minute.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Open Account > Settings > Delete Account. The account is deactivated immediately; order history is kept for legal and tax records.

question: How do I change my registered phone number?
answer: Open Account > Profile > Edit next to your phone number. Verify the new number with an OTP sent to it; the old number stops receiving alerts.

question: Why am I not receiving OTPs?
answer: Check that your number is correct and that SMS is not blocked. If OTPs still do not arrive, try the voice-call option or contact support.
